finalText:
**Redis went down. The rest is fallout.**

Timeline from [logs/app.log](logs/app.log):

| time | event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:08 | cache bypassed, direct store reads, miss storm |
| 02:14:10 | `TimeoutError` after 5000ms, store overloaded |
| 02:29:12 | `request queue depth 502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:26 | reconnect attempt 12 fails, still refused |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 reconnects got `ECONNREFUSED`. Nothing was listening there. So Redis was dead, not slow. Cache hit ratio was 0.98 at 02:13.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` stopped listening.
